description: GSM-R - Base stations on the network is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Infrabel. Quarterly evolution of the number of GSM-R antennas in service on the Infrabel network. Like an ordinary mobile phone, GSM-R is a mobile communication tool, but only for rail. The "R" in GSM-R therefore stands for "rail". Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are GSM-R, Basisstation, IT, Telecom, ERTMS. The portal shows 44 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-07-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
